description: This file defines a TypeScript module for a 'read_file' tool, including functions to generate support notes, create tool configurations with options for partial reads and image support, and exports a default read_file tool with partial reads disabled.

classes.name: ReadFileToolOptions
classes.description: Interface defining options for creating the read_file tool, including partialReadsEnabled, maxConcurrentFileReads, and supportsImages.

methods.name: getReadFileSupportsNote
methods.description: Generates a support note string indicating whether image processing is supported, mentioning supported file types.

methods.name: createReadFileTool
methods.description: Creates and returns a configuration object for the read_file tool, with customizable options for partial reads, max concurrent reads, and image support.
